english: O supreme commander of the hosts of heaven, we the unworthy entreat thee always, that by thy prayers thou wouldst encompass us with the shelter of the wings of thine immaterial glory, guarding us who fall down before thee diligently and cry aloud: deliver us from troubles, for thou art the commander of the hosts on high.

The glorious beheading of the Forerunner was a divine dispensation, that he might preach also to them that were in hades the coming of the Saviour. Let Herodias lament, who asked for a lawless murder; for she loved neither the law of God nor the living Life, but that which is deceitful and passing.
